analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($378.62) vs SMA5 ($362.19)/SMA20 ($366.09)/SMA50 ($348.90): Short-to-mid term trend above, entering bullish zone.
· Above SMA100 ($375.73), below SMA200 ($392.63): Mid-to-long term trend in transition.
· 52-week position (40.3%): Recovery zone from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.1→58.7): Exiting oversold, entering neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.3056→-0.3547): Continued improvement, in bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Midline $366.09): Sideways near midline, band width contracted to 9.60%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($373.04): Based on Pivot Point (PP $370.44), recovery confirmed.
· Swing resistance ($384.04): Breakout to confirm strengthening uptrend.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Confirms continuation of uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.30x): Low confidence in price movement.
· Current zone diagnosis (Uptrend): Entering long, expecting further upside on breaking first resistance.
